observations: All concepts in Torah #9 are accounted for within the existing package framework. The teaching organizes around three conceptual poles already captured by the proposed packages: (1) Prayer/Faith/Miracles/Eretz Israel as the positive transcendent cluster, (2) Egypt/Exile as the evil mirror, and (3) the Tzaddik/Mashiach as the mediating figure. The Tzaddik package (Package 3) is a well-established cross-Torah package type (צדיק הדור appears in many Torahs as its own cluster). The Earthly Outputs package (Package 5: מטה/זווג/ממון) is also a well-established type — it represents the material domain that prayer operates upon. No truly new package types emerge from Torah #9 that would require additions to the global package taxonomy. The teaching's structure is: [prayer + faith + miracles + land] → [tzaddik as conduit] → [union + sustenance], with exile/Egypt as the opposing force. This is a clean 3-package structure (good/evil/good-mediator) with one additional earthly-outputs cluster.
